newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker weak amid poor demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker weak amid poor demand.

text.p: The Singapore bunker quotes hovered around low levels on Wednesday amid few enquiries and poor demand, traders said.
"The cake has been reduced but still a lot of people want to share it," said one trader, noting recent poor demand. "There is only one direction for the market -- going down," he said.
Some suppliers said they prefered to stay on the sidelines rather than join the price-cutting.
The 380-cst was quoted at $96/$100 per tonne and the 180-cst at $102/$106. MDO and gas oil were quoted at around $190 and $200 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
